## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Testing

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] JavaScript syntax checks pass
- [ ] Dashboard tested
- [ ] Building Star-Ups tested
- [ ] Investments tested
- [ ] Desktop layout tested
- [ ] Mobile layout tested
- [ ] Offline/PWA behavior tested when applicable

## Screenshots

Add before/after screenshots for visible interface changes.

## Data and compatibility

- [ ] No calculator dataset or dependency logic changed
- [ ] Dataset or calculation changes include a reproducible expected result
- [ ] Stored browser data remains compatible, or migration impact is documented
- [ ] `sw.js` cache version/app shell was updated when required

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data were added
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` was updated for a notable user-facing change
